description: Validates an IBAN (MOD-97 checksum and country length, computed here) and, if it passes, looks up the bank name, city and BIC (SWIFT) through OpenIBAN's public validation. The bank lookup depends on OpenIBAN's directory and may be missing for some banks; a valid checksum does not prove the account exists. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: agent_intel_iban_routing_swift_resolver
title: Agent Intel Iban Routing Swift Resolver
